title: Learning Product Characteristics and Consumer Preferences from Search Data
authors: Luis Armona; Greg Lewis; Georgios Zervas
near_miss_reason: Hotel-entry event study is stacked-only: construct_entry_panel.py builds a separate +/-24-month panel of incumbents for each entry event, and entry_event_study_regs.do absorbs event x hotel (x calendar month) and event x date FE, with treatment = post-entry x 'close to entrant' (within the event's 10th distance percentile). The baseline column also enters three distance-based treatment interactions jointly. Package ships no real data (simulated only).
eligible_reason: No qualifying specification. The paper's main contribution is learning latent hotel characteristics from Expedia search data (BPR embeddings, BLP demand). Validation exercises: (a) hotel-entry event study (Figure 2 and a baseline table): stacked event-by-event panels with event-hotel and event-date FE; within each event entry occurs at one date for all incumbents, so the staggering comes only from stacking; (b) Marriott-Starwood merger: continuous exposure (share of Marriott/Starwood hotels in class) interacted with quarter dummies around a single merger date. Data (STR, Expedia) are under NDA; the package substitutes simulated noise data.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe) and Python (pyblp, keras/tensorflow). entry_event_study_regs.do: reghdfe log_demand c.event#c.lt_p10_{geo,str_mahal,search}_distance, absorb(event_hotel_id event_date_id) cluster(altid mkt_date); event-study version with dist_entry_{n13..p11} for each distance metric, absorb(event_hotelmonth_id event_date_id). marriott_merger.do: reghdfe log_price tq_ittX*, absorb(hotelmonth mkt_month / mktloc_month).

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design (event x hotel and event x date FE); three treatment interactions (geo, STR-observables, search distance) entered jointly
stacked event study (event x hotel x month and event x date FE), one distance metric at a time
continuous exposure (share of Marriott/Starwood hotels in class) x quarter, single merger date

data_files_note: README: STR and Expedia data under NDA; replication uses simulated noise data. The archive contains only public CPI and zip-code files; code/clean/construct_simulated_data.py generates the simulated STR/Expedia inputs (200 hotels, 5 markets).
data_provenance_note: No original data shipped; the only analysis inputs are simulated by the authors' script.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Near-miss on design (stacked-only entry event study) and excluded on data (synthetic).
